title:
Brand New Tool 🔥
Email Journey Mapper
body:
I've been working on this one for a hot minute, and I genuinely think it's going to help so many of you.

My favourite part? The actual map. You can see your entire email sequence laid out in front of you, so you know exactly where each email sits and what it's doing.

I absolutely love it, and I hope you do too.

accordion.title: Email Mapper: what it does
items: Plans your emails before you write them
You map the whole journey first, so every email has a clear purpose before you spend time on copy.
Starts you from a proven template
Choose the moment you're responding to: Welcome Sequence, Quiz / Lead Magnet, New Subscriber, Browse Abandonment, Post-Purchase or Weekly Sales Email. It loads a starting map you can change.
Sets the point of the journey
You decide the one goal, who enters, when they exit, and the offer it leads to.
Gives every email one job
Each email gets a subject line and preview text (with formulas to choose from), one job, a send time, who gets it, one call to action, and when to skip it.
Includes template guides
The Welcome Sequence has a guide for each email showing what to say and in what order.
Lets you write inside it
Write the email right there if you want to, with reminders for images and links.
Shows the full journey on one map
So you can check each email hands the reader on to the next.
Coaches you at every step
Each stage has a short voice note from me with key points, and every field has a "?" explaining why it matters.
Exports a branded PDF, Word doc or editable PDF
Each one includes an audit that flags what to fix before you write.
Keeps each journey separate
Starting a new one gives you a clean slate and reminds you to export the current one first.
